$comment: The props of Idle (lvgl-switch.md §2.1): what views/idle-props.mjs gives the face, with props.idle true and no frame but the one line. Props name what, never where: the people of the living window (a seed each), the bed, the painting's slot and the line; no rectangle, no measure, no layout rule, no colour (the face reads those from frame.json idle). Checked by prototypes/station/tests/idle-props.test.mjs (a JSON-Schema subset).
